'''icebreath Patience''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[David Kangas|icebreath]]
* '''Published:''' 19 October 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif|label=ISB Operations}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' ISB Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 ISB icebreath DS 2004 5856.txt |Download]] (omits Kuat Drive Yards (V), Tarkin (V), Mist Hunter (V), Black 2 (V), Imperial Propaganda (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

My best concept deck, ISB Senate.

'Defensive Shields - 10', all named (the Reflections III shields; Death Star Sentry (V) from Virtual Set 2). Secret Plans and Oppressive Enforcement here are the shields.

== Notes ==

* The four decks are the author's farewell set and post many unique cards in multiples (here Lott Dod x3, Tikkes x2, Yeb Yeb Adem'thorn x2, Mist Hunter (V) x2, Imperial Propaganda (V) x4); dested as posted.
* Original-era (V): Black 2 (V) (VS1); Death Star Sentry (V) (VS2, shield); Tarkin (V) (VS4); Mist Hunter (V) x2 (VS5); Kuat Drive Yards (V), Imperial Propaganda (V) x4, Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (VS6). The draft had dropped the (V) on Kuat Drive Yards.
* Coruscant: Docking Bay posted '(SE)': the Special Edition printing (same title). Zuckuss is unmarked: the printed Dagobah card. Drop! is the Coruscant Effect.
* Original-era printing corrected: Tarkin (V) (Virtual Set 4) -> Tarkin (V) (Virtual Set 3) (an earlier dest had linked the modern virtual card of the same name).

== Strategy ==

Third of four.  My final contributions to SWCCG.
